records.issue_text: AuthzClientCryptoProvider.java:108 does not validate signature.length == signLength before copying, silently discarding appended bytes and allowing distinct malformed signatures to produce the same DER signature.
records.rationale: Looking at the concatenatedRSToASN1DER method in AuthzClientCryptoProvider.java lines 104-120, the code calculates `int len = signLength / 2` and then copies from the signature array using `System.arraycopy(signature, 0, r, 1, len)` and `System.arraycopy(signature, len, s, 1, len)`. There is no validation that `signature.length == signLength`. If signature.length > signLength, the method will only process the first signLength bytes, silently ignoring any trailing bytes.
